_comment_accounting_dues: Dues and assessments for the accounting add-on (D-035). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting-receivables.enabled is true. It needs the accounting add-on, whose managers it calls, and a manager that holds the accounts it bills.
_comment_label: What the site calls the charge on the module's screens and emails. A condominium says Assessment, a landlord Rent, a club Dues; money lines show the chart category's own name (docs/guides/chart-of-accounts-guide.md).
_comment_accounts_manager: The manager that holds the accounts billed: list(), get(id), assessment(id) and lateCharges(). A condominium uses the accommodation add-on's AccommodationManager (ngdpbase-addons).
_comment_billing_manager: The manager that holds each account's billing parties on a date: billing(ctx, id, { on }), one invoice per party (D-038, D-040). A condominium uses the accommodation add-on's ResidencyManager (ngdpbase-addons).
_comment_send_to_owners: Whether invoices may be sent to owners (D-035). Off by default, so a development, test or copied site never mails real owners; a live site turns it on. It governs every send: the issue form's email box and the scheduled run.
_comment_issue_job: The scheduled invoice run, accounting-receivables.issue-invoices (D-035): the 1st of each month at 06:00 in the site's time zone, with late charges, emailed. Shipped paused: a site resumes it on Admin → Scheduled Jobs, and moves the day with BackgroundJobManager's own keys. While send-to-owners is off it sends nothing to owners.
_comment_categories: Chart codes a payment may be recorded under; the first is the one invoices charge. A list, so a site's value replaces this one.
_comment_organization: Who the invoices are from: the organization's name and postal address, and where to send payment.
_comment_database: The receivables add-on's own database (D-035): invoices, kept outside the ledger, which holds only money that moved. Never the accounting add-on's database. encrypt 'optional': SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set.

invoice-issue.description: Issue, void and email invoices for the site's charges (assessments, rent or dues)

account-read.description: See every unit's account: its invoices, payments and balance (the board)

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer bills the site's charges
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role issues and voids invoices, reading each unit's billing through the accommodation add-on's permission and the owners it emails through core's identity-read. Recording payments is the accounting add-on's ledger-record.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: The board reads every unit's account
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Core's executive role (the board, ngdpbase#2093) reads every unit's account (D-047, D-050): its invoices, payments and balance, its folios, and the balances brought forward, write-offs and liens recorded on them. It issues, voids and records nothing; that stays the treasurer's.

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: The scheduled invoice run issues invoices
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: A scheduled run of accounting-receivables.issue-invoices acts as the job (ngdpbase #1999): it holds only what issuing the month's invoices needs, reading each unit's billing through the accommodation add-on's permission and the owners it emails through core's identity-read. Run now acts as the admin who clicked.

_comment_account_read: account-read lets someone see every unit's account (invoices, payments, balance, folios) without the rest of the ledger: for the board (D-047). Core's executive role holds it through this add-on's policy (D-050); a site that keeps its board in another role grants it there in its own policy.
